title: Governance Policy
description: A `Governance Policy` entity represents a high-level governance rule that defines standards, requirements, and guidelines for data management, security, quality, and compliance within an organization.

policyStatus.description: Current status of the policy lifecycle

id.description: Unique identifier of this governance policy instance.

name.description: A unique name that identifies the governance policy.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this governance policy.

policyType.description: Type of governance policy (SECURITY, DATA_QUALITY, RETENTION, PRIVACY).

status.description: Current status of the policy (DRAFT, ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, UNDER_REVIEW).

domains.description: Domains that this governance policy belongs to.

reviewDate.description: Next scheduled review date for this policy in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

mutuallyExclusive.description: When `true`, assets can only be associated with one standard from this policy. When `false`, multiple standards from this policy can be applied simultaneously.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

impersonatedBy.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this governance policy.

reviewers.description: User references of the reviewers for this policy.

standards.description: Standards that implement this governance policy. This field is populated only when requested via the 'fields' query parameter.

tags.description: Tags associated with this governance policy.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.

provider.description: Provider type for this governance policy (system or user).

disabled.description: System governance policies can't be deleted. Use this flag to disable them.
